args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18 in status check). I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. The rollback is verified in all three regions. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Next steps: confirm error rate returns to baseline, investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), and the rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent release marked healthy in production. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging.
- **Before the rollback:** All regions were on v2.3.1, the service was unhealthy, and the error rate was 0.18.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the rollback and pages the on-call engineer.

I did not re-check the error rate after the rollback, so confirming that it has returned to baseline is still open. The incident also lists investigating the v2.3.1 failure before anything is re-released.
